customManagers.description: Track the pg_tle release built into the validation image and named in the install guide

packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps, not one per action per digest
One PR for image digest refreshes
The go directive and the golang image of the containerised suite move together
One PR for the golang.org/x modules
cel-go is the conformance oracle and stays exactly pinned (CLAUDE.md). Its PR is a deliberate re-measurement, never a routine merge.
prBodyNotes: Bumping cel-go moves the conformance oracle: update `internal/oracle.Version` in the same commit (a test fails while they differ), re-run the full suite, and re-measure any case whose verdict changes before merging.

packageRules.description: A PostgreSQL major changes the server every test and release check runs against
prBodyNotes: A PostgreSQL major moves the server CI, the release smoke test and the pg_tle image all run on: check that the pinned pg_tle release builds against it before merging.
